doctrine.title: Lightroom Portrait Editing Operating Doctrine
core_philosophy: Tools in combination beat individual sliders. The power layer is always tone curve + mask + HSL + color grading working together, not any single adjustment.
Masks are the primary compositing layer in modern Lightroom. For most portrait workflows they replace Photoshop localized adjustments.
Strongest photograph wins over most-processed. Every automated or layered output must beat the source image visually, not just complete the task.

1_cull.notes: Cull for story sequence first, technical quality second. Ratings set before any editing begins so edit energy is not wasted on rejects.

sliders_in_order: Blacks (set black point / film lift if desired)
2_global_exposure_foundation.notes: Establish the tonal range before touching color. Black point lift is the first step toward a film-look base.

3_tone_curve.role: Primary contrast and mood tool, not the basic sliders
3_tone_curve.portrait_shape: Gentle S-curve: slight lift in shadows (film base), slight pull in highlights. Avoid hard S which crushes skin.
3_tone_curve.film_look_variant: Raise shadow toe (blacks never hit zero), compress highlights, produces faded/lifted base consistent with analog emulation.
3_tone_curve.refine_saturation_slider: Use Tone Curve's Point mode. After contrast is dialed, bring Refine Saturation down if the curve is creating unwanted chroma spikes.

skin_tone_targets: Orange: primary skin hue. Luminance up = brighter skin; Saturation down = less orange-y.
Red: controls ruddy tones. Pull saturation slightly to de-pink.
Yellow: affects highlights and warm areas. Raise luminance if skin looks dull.
film_look_hsl: Warm shift: boost yellow/orange hue slightly toward warm, pull blues toward cyan.
Desaturate blues and greens to suppress background competition with subject.

three_wheel_doctrine: Shadows: slight warm or cool cast establishes mood.
Highlights: opposite of shadows for split-tone depth (warm shadows + cool highlights or reverse).
5_color_grading.notes: Color grading is additive on top of HSL. Do HSL first, grading second.

mask_types_in_priority_order: AI Subject: isolate person from background in one click. Refine with Subtract > Background if edges bleed.
AI Sky / Background: complement to Subject mask for environment-only edits.
Radial Gradient: localized dodge/burn on face. Feather 70-100% to avoid halos.
Luminance Range: target highlights or shadows globally without touching opposite tones.
Brush: precision catch-light and skin detail work.
6_masking_layer.softening_rule: After any AI mask, apply a softening gradient at the edge (Subtract > Linear Gradient set to low flow) to eliminate hard selection lines.
6_masking_layer.preset_on_mask: Lightroom presets can be applied inside a mask. Use a film-look preset on a Radial mask over the face to dodge and grade simultaneously.

catch_light_technique.name: Shard-of-light / catch-light precision
catch_light_technique.method: Brush tool, small size, 100% flow. Paint only the iris highlight. Raise Exposure +0.3 to +0.5, lower Contrast slightly. Do not paint the pupil.
catch_light_technique.result: Life in the eyes without cosmetic appearance.

skin_smoothing.safe_approach: AI Skin mask (or manual brush on face). Lower Texture -15 to -25. Leave Clarity untouched or at -5 max. Do not touch Sharpening inside mask.
skin_smoothing.guardrail: Never zero out Texture; it reads as plastic. Source photo texture sets the ceiling.

dodge_burn_portrait: Radial gradient over face: Exposure +0.20, Contrast -10 (brightens face, softens contrast locally).
Separate Radial on background: Exposure -0.30 to -0.50 (push background dark, force subject forward).

8_sharpening_and_noise.sharpening: Amount 40-60. Radius 1.0-1.2. Detail 25-40 (lower = less halo on skin). Masking 60-80 for portraits (holds edge sharpening only).
8_sharpening_and_noise.noise_reduction: Luminance NR first; use Masking slider inside Sharpening to protect smooth skin from NR artifacts. AI Denoise when shooting ISO 3200+.

sequence: 2. Tone curve: raise shadow toe to ~15-20 on the RGB curve.
3. Clarity -10 to -15 (subtle softness, analog diffusion feel).
5. Color grading: warm shadows, neutral-cool highlights.
9_film_look_complete_recipe.notes: Grain is the last step, applied after export-preview. Consistent grain size across the set = series cohesion.

sync_doctrine: Sync global tone/color across same-light selects first (Sync Settings, check only Tone Curve, HSL, Color Grading, Grain).
Do NOT sync masking across images with different subjects or backgrounds; masks are per-image.
After global sync, address individual outliers manually.
10_batch_editing.preset_layering: Stack presets additively. Base preset establishes foundation. Secondary preset (e.g., film grain, color shift) applied second and dialed back with Amount slider.

11_hdr_merge.when_to_use: Only when dynamic range exceeds camera sensor (blown sky + shadow detail both needed in same frame).
workflow: Select bracketed set in Library. Photo > HDR Merge. Enable Deghost (Medium for most scenes).
Do NOT enable Auto Tone in merge dialog; set tone manually after merge.
After merge, treat as normal raw. Tone curve is now critical because HDR files have more range to play with.

key_unique_techniques.name: Shard-of-light catch-light
key_unique_techniques.one_line: Tiny brush, iris only, +0.3-0.5 Exposure. Never paint the pupil.

key_unique_techniques.name: Narrative culling workflow
key_unique_techniques.one_line: Story sequence drives cull order; technical quality is secondary filter.

key_unique_techniques.name: Refine Saturation on tone curve
key_unique_techniques.one_line: In Point Curve mode, Refine Saturation slider decouples contrast from unwanted chroma boost.

key_unique_techniques.name: Preset inside a mask
key_unique_techniques.one_line: Apply full Lightroom preset inside a Radial mask for localized film-look dodge.

key_unique_techniques.name: Edge-softening subtract gradient
key_unique_techniques.one_line: After AI Subject mask, Subtract > Linear Gradient at low flow on the boundary to kill hard edges.

anti_patterns: Zeroing Texture on skin masks (reads plastic).
Syncing masking across images with different subjects.
Enabling Auto Tone in HDR merge dialog.
Applying heavy Clarity on top of film-look base (fights the softness).
Skipping the cull before editing (wastes edit cycles on rejects).
Over-relying on any single slider; the power layer is always combination.

primary_use_cases: Portrait retouching pipeline for client deliverables.
Film-look aesthetic development for IG editorial series.
HDR merge for architectural or lifestyle hybrid shoots.
sniped_routing.guardrail: All skin and identity edits follow the SNIPED identity-holds-always doctrine: texture, feature integrity, and authentic skin tone are non-negotiable floors regardless of workflow.
